answer: Voting weight comes from layered stakes that mature like shale: each new tranche of locked tokens reaches full weight only after twenty epochs, and early withdrawal forfeits accrued maturity. A farm's thousand fresh identities post a thousand new tranches, all frozen at near-zero weight for twenty epochs, while an honest agent's older layers keep counting. Trust threads along the maturity timeline, verified by deposit timestamp and sum, so weight scales with locked capital and time, never with account count; the meadow of cheap new names stays weightless until it earns its seasons.
